Subject: Clarification on Routine Expense Claim Process

Dear Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to clarify the routine process for submitting expense claims for your reference. Kindly ensure that all claims are submitted within 15 days of the end of the month in which the expenses were incurred.

The process involves the following steps:
1. Complete the expense claim form in full.
2. Attach all original receipts as proof of expenditure.
3. Submit the claim to your direct supervisor for review.
4. Upon approval, forward the claim to the finance department at [Finance Department Email].

Should you have any queries or require further assistance at any stage, please do not hesitate to reach out. We are here to support you and ensure the process runs smoothly.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Position]
[Your Contact Information]
